verdict.rationale: OCI can be driven entirely without the Console. Its CLI matches Console functionality and installs on Linux, Mac and Windows. It also offers REST APIs, multi-language SDKs and an official Terraform provider, all of which suit headless automation scripts and pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions/Jenkins integration guides), documented non-interactive auth patterns for CI runners, independent hands-on corroboration of using OCI from CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The CLI provides the same core functionality as the Console, plus additional commands.
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure APIs are typical REST APIs that use HTTPS requests and responses.
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Terraform provider is a component that connects Terraform to the OCI services that you want to manage.
To use the CLI without a keypair, you can use token-based authentication.
